tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Best first call. Give the destination (or all destinations of a multi-country trip) and trip length, plus how the traveler uses data if known. Returns up to 3 options with a reason each: best_fit (cheapest that covers the estimated need), budget (cheaper, below the estimate) and roomier (next size u

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: List plans for a destination, cheapest first, single-country plans before multi-country ones. Filter by trip length, minimum GB, and plan type.

tools.name: estimate_data
tools.description: Same formula as bloomyesim.com/data-calculator: daily MB per activity x days x Wi-Fi factor x 1.15 safety buffer, rounded up.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Countries with a dedicated plan, with ISO code, localized name, number of plans and the lowest price. Use query to filter.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Details of one plan: data, validity, network, 5G, top-up, carriers, price and checkout link.

tools.name: get_purchase_link
tools.description: Link straight to the final confirmation screen for this plan. The traveler pays there themselves; this tool never takes payment. The QR code is emailed and shown in My Page right after payment.

tools.name: get_setup_guide
tools.description: Short, accurate setup steps (iPhone or Android), what to check before buying, and links to the full guide, the device checker and troubleshooting.
